title: Track fs/copy_chunk_dev_full.lu outside the contained filesystem path domain
witness: fs/copy_chunk_dev_full.lu is unsupported by name under os.fs.path.domain on lupin, before and after is81. The in-tree read-only sink now rewinds and retries all 17 bytes, and the Rust-level /dev/full writer reports ENOSPC with zero accepted bytes.
recommendation: Keep the production path boundary; track an admissible device-witness strategy separately. Do not broaden it as a convenience fix.
